name: Miscellaneous Single-Purpose Actions
description: Smaller action types that don't need their own file. Each is a complete, self-contained exec with the args shape observed in the codebase.

entries.description: Shows the global loading spinner. Takes no args. Typically the first action in a whenclick chain before a slow operation (confirm dialog, procedure call).
Runs a raw JS expression/statement via the 'js' key (not 'args'). Used sparingly — only for things with no dedicated action, e.g. browser history navigation.
Client-side page navigation. args is a binding expression resolving to the target, not a literal path string.
Forces re-fetch/refresh of the listed datasets, e.g. after a save so toolbar-state datasets (New/Edit/Delete/Print button enablement) recompute.
Runs a set of deferred/queued events, typically after-save hooks stored in a dataset field.

note: No 'showsnackbar' exec exists in this codebase — use action.setdataset targeting the 'snackinfo' dataset instead. No REST/fetch/axios action exists — all server calls go through filldataset/fillmultidataset.
